chunks: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.

key_terms.اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ: Allah, the Eternal Refuge / The Self-Sufficient
key_terms.لَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ: There is none comparable or equivalent to Him
key_terms.وَلَمْ يُولَدْ: And He was not born (from a parent)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Surah Al-Ikhlas in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, Surah Al-Ikhlas is revered as equivalent to one-third of the Quran due to its comprehensive exposition of Tawhid, a theme echoed in the hadith of the Prophet regarding its divine weight. It serves as a foundational creed for understanding God's absolute oneness (Ahadiyyah) and uniqueness (Fardiyyah), free from anthropomorphism or multiplicity. This concise declaration is frequently cited by Imams to refute theological deviations and affirm the purity of monotheism.
